What changed in this PR Introduces the first typed, non-empty, read-only “CORE” board snapshot decoder for Apple platforms, aligned to the pinned backend contract revision `0.1.20`, and expands fixture governance/provenance checks plus fixture-backed decoding coverage. **Changes:** - Adds typed `PublicGameSnapshot` decoding (and related board-domain model types) for both REST `GetGame` and WebSocket `GameUpdate` envelopes via `ContractJSON`. - Vendors and governs additional contract fixtures/schemas (including `get-game` / `game-update` and focused sub-shape fixtures) and updates digests/pins to backend commit `7611b60abc1f0107abfba2c1939e4d170e20d948`. - Adds focused + adversarial tests validating decoding invariants (mode branches, turn bounds, disjoint location variants, The RuntimeCost docstring claims “unknown keys fail closed”, but the Codable implementation does not reject additional properties (and the tests explicitly rely on forward-compatible decoding). Please update the comment to match actual behavior, or implement closed-key enforcement if that’s the intended contract boundary.
This test’s name says RuntimeCost “fails closed”, but the body asserts decoding succeeds with an unexpected extra key. Rename the test (and function) to reflect what it actually verifies.
